rows.note: Use 功勞 as the all-purpose noun for an achievement or contribution that deserves recognition or reward.

example.english: Everyone deserves merit for making this project such a success.
example.traditional: 呢次個項目做得咁成功，大家都有功勞。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 go3 hong6 muk6 zou6 dak1 gam3 sing4 gung1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 gung1 lou4

rows.note: Use 優點 when the merit is a good quality or feature rather than a particular achievement.

example.english: The biggest merit of this phone is its long battery life.
example.traditional: 呢部手機最大嘅優點係電量襟用。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 jau1 dim2 hai6 din6 loeng6 kam1 jung6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that someone or something deserves praise, attention, or a good result.

example.english: This proposal is worth serious consideration and may merit approval.
example.traditional: 呢個提議值得大家認真考慮，甚至可能值得批准。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 zik6 dak1 daai6 gaa1 jing6 zan1 haau2 leoi6 sam6 zi3 ho2 nang4 zik6 dak1 pai1 zeon2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on earning or winning an actual response, reward, or recognition, such as applause.

example.english: Their speech did enough to merit a round of applause from the whole audience.
example.traditional: 佢嗰場演講贏得全場掌聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 coeng4 jin2 gong2 jeng4 dak1 cyun4 coeng4 zoeng2 sing1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone is entitled to receive something because they deserve it.

example.english: They worked so hard and merit this award.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 nou5 lik6 jing1 dak1 ni1 go3 zoeng2
